PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Photoelectric effect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — newton (N)

2. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

3. D — Glucose and oxygen

4. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. B — Producers

6. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.

7. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

8. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.

10. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.

11. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.

12. D — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
